evidence.locator: Version-of-record methods and pinned GSK26-public 815b610b3beddfed5a3abf611d3a465ab9e4ce5c source audit
evidence.supports: Five imaging mice, paired M1/S1 recording sessions, calcium-derived neural features and measured joint kinematics; author analysis and prospective train-only decoder differ.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Existing generated construction controls retain their original engineering scope. No authentic-data model result for this task was established by this inspection; the historical EEG077/sleep007 programme pilot is a separate scope.
excluded_claims: Native neural understanding from programme accuracy.
Authentic source/author parity, online prediction, population-generalized uncertainty or cross-mouse transfer.

disposition_reason: The complete five-mouse/ten-session normalized-data decoder and measured-target scorer exist. Authentic native extraction, trial eligibility, clock/ROI alignment and protected participant delivery remain unverified; use the declared retrospective session-local endpoint, not an author-reproduction or cross-animal-transfer claim.

scientific_target.question: How accurately can session-local M1 or S1 calcium-derived activity predict measured joint angles or velocities on complete held-out lift-conditioned reach windows beyond phase and reach-target references?
scientific_target.known_answer: The 24 ordered measured jointAngles trajectories in degrees OR the 24 jointVelocities trajectories in degrees/second, scored in separate requests; they are not a single 48-channel endpoint.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Source R/M kinematic measurements and corresponding event-locked native trial identities; normalized values require an authenticated operator extraction.
scientific_target.case_unit: One original reach trial with all 51 samples from -100 to +400 ms relative to liftTimeDLC, nested within a named imaging session.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Five mice cfa17,cfa19,cfa20,cfa22,cfa24; two M1/S1 sessions each are dependent observations.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective event-conditioned, within-session held-out-trial readout. An explicit local-calibration condition fits separate new-mouse session models; no neural identity or model parameters transfer across animals.
exclusions: No online or causal movement prediction: lift conditioning and symmetric/upstream processing use retrospective information.
No author Figure 5 reproduction: train-only variance selection, PCA, fixed ridge, split and NRMSE differ from author analysis.
No inference that calcium-derived events or 10 ms resampling are independently sampled spikes.

inputs: Primary delivered recipe: 100 training-variance-selected session-local ROI features from smoothed deconvolved events (source neurons.data, 35 ms smoothing SD), 51 samples at 10 ms spacing, no added predictor lags.
Public lift-time grid and left/right reach target are shared with comparators; all fits, cell ranking, centering and 90-component PCA use declared training trials only.
RADICaL is a separately declared feature track with upstream temporal support at least [-200,+900] ms; it is not silently exchanged with primary features.
forbidden_inputs: Held-out kinematic trajectories, evaluation-derived cell selection/PCA/normalization, full-session ZETA selection, answer-bearing filenames and private scorer compound request.
Any undeclared extra upstream observation window or cross-session ROI correspondence.
observation_contract.case_identity: Exact normalized session IDs are the ten identities enumerated in SCHEMA.md; original trial IDs must match neural_trial_id and target_trial_id. Native admitted trial census is not yet available.
observation_contract.split: Implemented prospective within-session split is whole-trial target-stratified SHA256 ranking with seed 240926, 90/10 train/evaluation and upward-rounded evaluation counts; no timepoint split. Five separately declared local-calibration outer cases are optional and are not parameter transfer.
observation_contract.coverage: All five mice, both named areas/sessions, every selected trial, all 51 time points and all 24 joints required. Exact native eligibility/exclusion counts remain unverified; selected windows do not imply complete reaching behavior ends by +400 ms.

primary.name: Mouse-macro training-SD-normalized RMSE
primary.aggregation: RMSE per session/joint over equally weighted complete trials/time points divided by that joint training population SD; equal 24 joints, equal two sessions within mouse, equal five mice.
primary.rationale: Scores measured kinematics directly while retaining biological weighting and training-only normalization; fixed-source prediction agreement is not the target.

secondary: Within-session/joint SSE/SST R² then equal sessions/mice; constant target variance remains undefined.
Per-area and per-joint errors, phase/target comparator differences and trial-shift diagnostic; angles and velocities remain separate.

comparators.name: Frozen session-local neural ridge
comparators.inputs: Identical training calcium and kinematics; query neural features only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented training variance ranking, 100 ROIs, 90 PCA components, unpenalized target mean and ridge alpha 1 in sum-SSE units.

comparators.name: Phase-by-direction mean
comparators.inputs: Training kinematics plus public lift grid and reach target.
comparators.procedure: Implemented training-only average trajectory for each reach direction; separate phase-only and direction-only means retained.

comparators.name: Whole-training-trial neural rotation
comparators.inputs: Same complete training neural trajectories within each direction.
comparators.procedure: Implemented cyclic rotation by original trial order followed by identical fit; diagnostic, not a permutation significance test.

nuisance_controls: Train-only cell selection/PCA; original trial-identity equality instead of positional neural/kinematic pairing.
Fixed same cell and window budgets in M1/S1; source eligibility and upstream exposure must be frozen and disclosed.
Session-local feature spaces; never infer matched neurons or cross-animal transfer from equal array widths.
evaluation.uncertainty: Retain five mouse differences and descriptive paired enumeration of all 5^5 ordered mouse bootstrap resamples; five animals do not establish population coverage or a significance threshold.
evaluation.failure_policy: Missing/extra trials, sessions, ROI identities, time points or joints and nonfinite values reject. Zero training SD or evaluation variance propagates undefined scores without dropping affected joints/mice.

implementation.scorer_target: pipeline.score_predictions computes complete measured-target NRMSE and R²; run_reference_controls produces phase/direction and whole-trial-rotation comparisons.
implementation.delivered_scope: Numerical fit/predict/score/control source for normalized admitted data, including all ten named sessions; no native MAT intake or participant isolation is delivered.
missing: Authenticate all native MAT/clock/trial/eligibility and upstream processing records and freeze exact census.
Construct participant-only views and protected complete-output collection; qualify the actual reference on authentic inputs.
implementation.execution_evidence: Published generated construction tests check fitting, scoring, held-out perturbation invariance and numerical failure cases. No authentic model execution was performed in this revision.
